pi.name: Prof. Ariel D. Chipman
pi.bio: Ariel Chipman is an Associate Professor of Evolutionary Developmental Biology in the Department of Ecology, Evolution and Behavior at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem. He earned his B.Sc., M.Sc., and Ph.D. from the Hebrew University, followed by postdoctoral research at the University of Cambridge under Prof. Michael Akam. His work focuses on comparative embryology, developmental genomics, and arthropod evolution. He serves as an editor for leading evolutionary biology journals and has co-led major international arthropod genome projects.
